text.zh-CN: 原报告给予维生素 B6 并建议康复；家属在家进行手活动、音乐与交流训练，6 个月随访无明显加重，未证明疾病逆转。
text.en: Vitamin B6 and rehabilitation were described; the family used hand activities, music and interaction at home. No obvious worsening was reported at six months, without proof of disease reversal.

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 表型与 MECP2 变异支持 Rett 综合征
text.en: The phenotype and MECP2 variant support Rett syndrome

feedback.zh-CN: 刻板手动作、语言/步态问题与检测一致。
feedback.en: Hand stereotypies, language/gait difficulties and the variant are concordant.

text.zh-CN: 正常脑电图即可解释为完全正常发育
text.en: Normal EEG establishes normal development

feedback.zh-CN: 脑电图不评估所有发育功能。
feedback.en: EEG does not assess all developmental functions.

text.zh-CN: 所有重复动作都是癫痫
text.en: All repetitive movements are epilepsy

feedback.zh-CN: 本例缺少发作证据，既往治疗无效。
feedback.en: Seizure evidence is absent and previous treatment did not help.

prompt.en: How should follow-up care be arranged?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。

text.zh-CN: 神经、遗传与康复团队评估功能、并发症及当前可用治疗
text.en: Neurology, genetics and rehabilitation teams assess function, complications and current treatment options

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把旧文“无特异治疗”当作今天的完整信息。
feedback.en: The old claim of no specific treatment is not complete current information.

text.zh-CN: 维生素 B6 已证明逆转疾病
text.en: Vitamin B6 is proven to reverse the disorder

feedback.zh-CN: 该单例不提供这种证据。
feedback.en: The case supplies no such evidence.

text.zh-CN: 只要没有抽搐就无需随访
text.en: No seizures means no follow-up is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 交流、运动及其他系统风险仍需照护。
feedback.en: Communication, movement and other risks remain relevant.

prompt.en: How should genetic counselling be framed?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 父母该位点阴性支持散发可能，但不等于排除所有复发风险
text.en: Negative parental testing supports a possible de novo event but does not exclude every recurrence risk

feedback.zh-CN: 检测范围和嵌合等问题需遗传专科说明。
feedback.en: Testing scope and mosaicism questions require specialist counselling.

text.zh-CN: 父母阴性就绝无再发可能
text.en: Negative parents mean zero recurrence risk

text.zh-CN: 任一 MECP2 变异都可脱离临床直接确诊
text.en: Any MECP2 variant diagnoses Rett without phenotype

feedback.en: Clinical and variant interpretation remain necessary.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 临床与 MECP2 检测共同支持 Rett 综合征，需持续多学科照护。
conclusion.en: Clinical findings and MECP2 testing support Rett syndrome and ongoing multidisciplinary care.

keyReasoning.en: Stereotyped movements are not synonymous with epilepsy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: FDA 2023 已批准 trofinetide；是否适用及可及性需专科核对，不能照搬旧治疗观。
keyReasoning.en: FDA approved trofinetide in 2023; suitability and local access require specialist review rather than copying historical treatment assumptions.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 父母单个位点阴性不是零遗传风险证明。
keyReasoning.en: Negative parental testing at one site does not prove zero genetic recurrence risk.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
